description: This file provides functions to extract text from various file formats including TXT, PDF, DOCX, and XLSX. It offers a public interface to process raw file bytes, detect file type based on filename extension, and extract the textual content, supporting large Excel files with specialized chunking methods. Additionally, it includes utility functions for token estimation, metadata extraction, and summarization previews.

methods.name: Tuple[str,Optional[str]] extract_text_from_bytes(filename: str, content: bytes)
methods.description: Extracts readable text from a file, based on filename extension, supporting txt, pdf, docx, and xlsx formats.

methods.name: str _extract_txt(content: bytes)
methods.description: Decode bytes as UTF-8, ignoring errors.

methods.name: str _extract_pdf(content: bytes)
methods.description: Extract text from PDF content using pdfminer.six.

methods.name: str _extract_docx(content: bytes)
methods.description: Extract text from DOCX files including paragraphs and table cells.

methods.name: str _extract_xlsx(content: bytes)
methods.description: Extract text from XLSX files, representing sheets and cells as tab-separated values.

methods.name: int _estimate_tokens(s: str)
methods.description: Estimate token count for a string, assuming approximately 4 characters per token.

methods.name: str _stringify(cell: Any)
methods.description: Convert a cell value to a string for display.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _compute_column_stats(values: List[Any])
methods.description: Compute basic statistics for a column of data; supports numeric and non-numeric data.

methods.name: List[str] extract_xlsx_wide_chunks( content: bytes, max_tokens_per_chunk: int = 1200, row_chunk_size: int = 100, base_sample_columns: int = 5, random_sample_columns: int = 3, stats_sample_rows: int = 200, )
methods.description: Create chunks of wide Excel data, including metadata, sampled rows, and per-column stats, constrained by token budget for large files.

methods.name: str summarize_text_preview(text: str, max_chars: int = 500)
methods.description: Generate a short preview string of extracted text, suitable for UI display.

methods.name: flush_chunk(rows: List[List[Any]], start_idx: int, end_idx: int)

ctags.name: extract_text_from_bytes
ctags.pattern: /^def extract_text_from_bytes(filename: str, content: bytes) -> Tuple[str, Optional[str]]:$/

ctags.name: extract_xlsx_wide_chunks
ctags.signature: ( content: bytes, max_tokens_per_chunk: int = 1200, row_chunk_size: int = 100, base_sample_columns: int = 5, random_sample_columns: int = 3, stats_sample_rows: int = 200, )

ctags.name: flush_chunk
ctags.pattern: /^        def flush_chunk(rows: List[List[Any]], start_idx: int, end_idx: int):$/
